purpose: Follow-up on the broad exact-name sweep for ZIP names found under the Weber restart tree and nearby old-physics/Maxwell subfolders. This is an archive-intake and public-status decision manifest, not a loose upload list.

decisions.decision: Do not route into Weber. These are Maxwell/old-physics artifacts that happen to live under the Weber restart tree. The current Maxwell public page already distinguishes the reader-facing source-witnessed sequence pp.001-079 from older ledger/backstop and raw IA source files. The large IA/DLI JP2/JPG/raw ZIPs are source/provenance candidates only and should not be fronted unless a curated Maxwell source bundle is explicitly needed.

Treat as superseded or already public backstop. Batches 42-52, 97-103, and related earlier cumulative packages are older than the published Batch137/B138/B139 Weber record and should not be re-uploaded as current reader surfaces.

The only detected item is a duplicate-named Batch125 Section157 ZIP with ' (1)' suffix. Batch125 without the duplicate suffix is already present in the public Weber latest record, so this is no new upload action.

Keep as support/provenance unless deliberately repackaged. The handoff chunks contain older work ZIPs; source cutouts, gap-closure triage files, and ledgers are useful to future repair work but should remain behind clear provenance labels.

Mixed bucket after sampling. Some are older Vol. I cumulative packages; some are source-cutout/queue packages; `ly.zip` is actually a Noether RA14 Paper 01 source-critical package misfiled under Weber and should be routed to Noether/source-intake rather than Weber.

public_facing_caveats_to_keep: Weber remains a working/source-audit repair lane, not a critical edition.
Public Weber readers should continue to front the latest compact B137/B138/B139 and post-public B140-B145/Phase2 status, not older nested handoff bricks.
Maxwell belongs on the old-physics/Maxwell record, not Weber, even when local files live under the Weber restart folder.
OCR, source-cutout, handoff, and ledger ZIPs are locator/provenance layers unless promoted by a source-specific audit.
next_actions: No new Weber upload is implied by this exact-name sweep slice.
If a future Weber compact refresh appears after B145/Phase2, prefer that over old Batch42-103 and handoff chunks.
